Definition and scope: NZD principal available within the stated NZD retail term-deposit product, original term and horizon
Illustrative treatment: Fixed segment amounts independent of the numerical sample
Data required for calibration: Eligible market flows by term, channel, customer segment and balance tier, reconciled to the market perimeter
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Low/high opportunity at fixed offers and after reoptimisation, and 1k/5k/25k draws at fixed opportunity
Known uncertainty: Public sector stocks have different product, residency and sector coverage

Definition and scope: Point-in-time liability stock, with product, sector, currency and residency matched before comparison
Illustrative treatment: Phase 4a source register DEP-01 to DEP-03 provides public context. Profiles use invented amounts
Data required for calibration: Dated matched stock, explicit segment allocation, comparable time series and revisions
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Flow profile versus equivalent stock-derived profile after transformation
Known uncertainty: Public account stocks or repricing buckets cannot identify bank-specific annual tenderable balances

Definition and scope: Principal eligible to reprice or enter over one common horizon
Illustrative treatment: Explicit maturity transformation for any stock input
Data required for calibration: Contractual maturity ladder, behavioural runoff including early redemptions, and separately attributed external inflows
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Zero versus positive horizon maturity assumptions and matched hand-calculated flow reconciliation
Known uncertainty: Residual repricing term differs from original term. Aggregate stock changes mix new funding, runoff and transfers

Definition and scope: Reachable fraction of the addressable principal over the horizon
Illustrative treatment: Bounded synthetic input applied before product eligibility and response
Data required for calibration: Offer exposure and reachable principal denominators by comparable term, tier and channel
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Low/high reachable share with other supply assumptions held fixed
Known uncertainty: Reach can overlap across channels and terms without a disjoint assignment

Definition and scope: Reachable principal eligible for the product offer
Illustrative treatment: Bounded segment-specific assumption applied before conversion
Data required for calibration: Eligible and excluded offers, minimum balance and tier rules, customer segments and exposure denominators
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Zero/full participation and matched tier allocation across numerical sample sizes
Known uncertainty: Product availability and observed channel participation may be confounded with reach or conversion

Definition and scope: Probability of uptake conditional on availability and offer
Illustrative treatment: Existing synthetic own-rate and competitor-gap response on unmodified features
Data required for calibration: Accepted and rejected offers, quoted and booked balances, matched competitor terms/rates and independent rate variation
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Low/high conversion at fixed offers and after reoptimisation, plus zero and full conversion tests
Review owner: Deposits and Pricing with independent Model Risk
Known uncertainty: Own-rate and competitor-gap effects cannot be separately estimated with a fixed competitor rate

Definition and scope: Gross explicitly classified bookings, net funding versus the stated reference and usable funding in the modelled portfolio
Illustrative treatment: Separate gross bookings and eligible credit against the synthetic reference funding position
Data required for calibration: Linked source-of-funds and opening-to-closing balance reconciliation, usable funding allocation and Treasury eligibility rules
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Hand reconciliation of external flows, actual runoff, usable volume and wholesale cost
Known uncertainty: Booked principal alone cannot identify the counterfactual source or the liquid balance available to the modelled portfolio

Definition and scope: Booked maturity principal and the subset with explicit avoided external runoff
Illustrative treatment: Recognise eligible retained principal against stated counterfactual maturity runoff
Data required for calibration: Vintage-level maturities, retention offers, balances retained or withdrawn and evidence for outflow without the offer
Sensitivity or validation comparison: High renewal/retention profile and no-supported-runoff control
Known uncertainty: Renewals include funds that would have stayed without the offer

Definition and scope: Deposit principal sourced from another held product or tier
Illustrative treatment: Internal transfers conserve bank-wide funding with interest expense measured against the source product
Data required for calibration: Linked transfers, existing held balances, source-product interest, offer costs and displacement
Sensitivity or validation comparison: High migration profile and zero-consolidated-inflow hand reconciliation
Known uncertainty: Product substitution may be misclassified as external new money if holdings are unlinked

Definition and scope: Booked interest, source-product counterfactual interest and acquisition or retention cost
Illustrative treatment: Explicit synthetic expense assumptions with absolute and incremental expense separately visible
Data required for calibration: Product-level interest and cost attribution, cash-flow timing and controlled marginal acquisition or retention evidence
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Fixed-offer expense waterfall and high-cannibalisation case
Known uncertainty: Annualised model interest cannot establish actual timing or marginal servicing and retention costs

Definition and scope: Usable funding exposed to a specified deposit pool and proposed cap
Illustrative treatment: Synthetic hard-limit recognition cap or separate soft penalty or diagnostic-only threshold
Data required for calibration: Connected depositor holdings, maturity/channel concentrations, eligible liquidity policy and stress evidence
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Binding hard-cap stress and equivalent soft and diagnostic settings, with constrained volume disclosed
Known uncertainty: Numerical sample row weights do not measure individual depositor concentration

Definition and scope: One stated horizon for opportunity flows and comparable original booking term
Illustrative treatment: Single-horizon simulation with no automatic reuse of its opportunity in the existing annual roll
Data required for calibration: Term-level opening stock, vintages, maturity and rollover schedules, contractual cash flows and reconciliation by funding category
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Single-horizon runoff accounting and existing Phase 3b full-runoff and vintage regression cases
Known uncertainty: No term-matched ALM valuation or validated repeated-booking model

Definition and scope: Required usable deposit funding and separately measured shortfall penalty
Illustrative treatment: Existing balance-sheet formulas applied to eligible usable balances on the simulation basis
Data required for calibration: Approved target and denominator with a matched term and Treasury funding basis
Sensitivity or validation comparison: Zero target and high required funding ratio under supply stress
Review owner: Treasury/ALM and Pricing with independent Model Risk
Known uncertainty: Shortfall steering differs from wholesale cash expense and the prudential funding ratio
